Found in February data, 2026-07-27. Checked last — an order already claimed by any earlier group never lands here.. Order-level rows (no per-product breakdown) with full session history. Groups are checked in a fixed priority order (DM-Ad -> Meta -> Sonya -> Sajeepan -> Sukirtha -> Organic -> CPPC -> Thishoban) so no order can appear in more than one group's tab.
